title: ObjectBeamGeometricallyExact2D has no GetAngularVelocityLocal and ObjectANCFBeam no GetLocalCenterOfMass, although they declare the access functions that need them
author: Claude-JG
description: ObjectBeamGeometricallyExact2D declares AngularVelocity_qt (it provides GetRotationJacobian) and inherits the throwing default of GetAngularVelocityLocal: a RigidBodySpringDamper on a MarkerBodyRigid of the beam stops at the first step with 'illegal call to CObjectBody::GetAngularVelocityLocal', and so does the output AngularVelocityLocal of the marker. ObjectANCFBeam declares DisplacementMassIntegral_q (GetMassWeightedPositionJacobian) and inherits the throwing default of GetLocalCenterOfMass, which CMarkerBodyMass::GetPosition calls. Found by the table of revision2026c step RG9.6.1 (#2866); fixed with the static_asserts of RG9.6.2.
releaseNotes: ObjectANCFBeam provides GetLocalCenterOfMass (the middle of the beam axis) and ObjectBeamGeometricallyExact2D provides GetAngularVelocityLocal, as their access function types declare; a MarkerBodyMass on the ANCF beam and a RigidBodySpringDamper on a MarkerBodyRigid of the 2D beam raised 'illegal call' before. Test model beamMarkerAccessTest.py.
